transcript.text: This is a picture of me at rock bottom.
It was Christmas Eve, I was living at my
girlfriend's parents' house in their
extra bedroom. And I'm the guy she just
met on the internet that you just quit
her job for, that just lost everything.
My business partner took all the money
I'd made from selling my gyms, and I
just found out the $100,000 that I'd put
in to launch this new business was
getting held up by the processor, and I
had to pay all my bills, and since my
last payment leaving only $1,000 left in
my bank account. And I was like, "I
think you should leave me. I think I'm a
sinking ship right now, and I would
respect you, like we're cool if you want
to walk away, and I would walk away from
you right now." She pulled my chin
towards hers, and she said, "I would
sleep with you under a bridge if it came
to that." If you find a girl who
believes in your dreams more than you
do, who makes you want to be a better
man, who's willing to work alongside you
to get there, and is grateful for
whatever you have today, just marry her.
Because at the end of the day, your
spouse marries two people, the person
you are and the person you're going to
become. Make sure they love both.
